body.html: JinPlace Hostel, known locally as Jin Place Hostel, is a budget hostel/serviced-apartment-style stay at 576 Moo 4, Chayangkun Road, in the Ban Khok Chakkachan community of Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen district · What sets it apart from an ordinary guesthouse is that these are private air-conditioned rooms that come almost fully equipped like an apartment — a fridge, microwave, hot water, TV and a small kitchen corner — at a rate in the hundreds of baht · It suits travellers staying several nights, working in town, or passing through and wanting a clean, ready-to-go room.

The rooms are newly designed air-conditioned rooms with a large bed, simply and cleanly furnished · A point the reviews keep raising is the bathroom, which is larger than a typical hostel's, with good hot water, plus welcome snacks and drinks left in the room · They feel more like a private apartment than a shared dorm — well suited to couples, solo travellers, or anyone working in town who wants their own space.
"New, clean rooms with a large bathroom and all the essentials in the room, a kind owner, easy parking right at the door and a quiet setting. Great value for what you get."

What you get beyond expectations at this price is free private parking right at the door, free laundry and Wi-Fi that is genuinely strong · There is a shaded outdoor sitting area in the garden, and because JinPlace sits in the same compound as Jin Pool Villa, guests can share the swimming pool — rare at this price point · It is a small property with few guests, so it stays quiet and private, suited to those who want a good night's sleep more than a social scene.

On location, JinPlace sits in the Ban Khok Chakkachan area on the edge of Amnat Charoen · It is only about 1.7–2.3 km from the town centre and the clock tower, a few minutes' drive to markets, restaurants and government offices · There is a gym and temples a short drive off, and Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park is not far · It is a spot that gives you the quiet of the outskirts while keeping the town easily reachable — best for self-drivers.

To be straight, per the real reviews: this is a small property with not many public reviews, so the high score of around 9.0 comes from a modest number of guests and reads as a general signal only · It also has no breakfast or restaurant, no permanently staffed front desk like a big hotel, and an outskirts location that means driving into town for meals · So if you expect full hotel service, this is not it · But if the brief is a new, clean room that comes with its own essentials at a low price, it answers it squarely.

In short, JinPlace Hostel suits solo travellers, couples or anyone in town for work who wants a new, clean air-conditioned room with a kitchenette and in-room essentials in the hundreds of baht · You get free parking at the door, free laundry, shared use of the villa's pool and an outskirts location that is still easy to reach the town from · It is for self-drivers who value good value and privacy more than full town-hotel service · But because it is a small property, it is worth comparing the latest photos and reviews and messaging the owner to confirm a room before booking.

A tip from following the reviews here: message the owner ahead about check-in and using the villa side's pool so you make the most of what is in the compound · There is a kitchenette, fridge and microwave in the room, so since there is no breakfast you can pick up food and heat it yourself, or drive into town only about 1.7 km away · And because parking is right at the door, loading up is easy — handy if you are self-driving and staying several nights.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — JinPlace Hostel Amnat Charoen

faq.q: Where is JinPlace Hostel, and what is nearby?
faq.a: JinPlace Hostel is at 576 Moo 4, Chayangkun Road, in the Ban Khok Chakkachan community, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen · It is only about 1.7–2.3 km (a ~5–6 minute drive) from the town centre and clock tower · It is near the Consume the Iron gym (~1.4 km) and Sarakhet Temple (~2.2 km) · An outskirts spot that is quiet but easy to reach town from, in the same compound as Jin Pool Villa.

faq.q: How much does JinPlace Hostel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start at about ฿550/night for a standard A/C room · There is a deluxe room with a kitchenette and a large-bed room with a sitting area at roughly ฿650–฿750 · All rooms are air-conditioned with in-room essentials — fridge, microwave and hot water · Rates vary by season and room type, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does JinPlace Hostel have a pool and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there is free private parking right at the door, and guests can use the swimming pool shared with Jin Pool Villa in the same compound · There is genuinely strong free Wi-Fi, free laundry and a garden sitting area · Rooms have a fridge, microwave and hot water, but there is no breakfast service.

faq.q: Who is JinPlace Hostel best for?
faq.a: It suits solo travellers, couples or anyone in town for work who wants a new, clean air-conditioned room with a kitchenette and in-room essentials in the hundreds of baht · Good for self-drivers who value good value and privacy · Not ideal for anyone wanting full town-hotel service or a walkable town-centre base.

faq.q: What are the rooms and service at JinPlace Hostel like?
faq.a: Per the real reviews, rooms are newly designed, clean, with a large bathroom and apartment-like in-room essentials, the owner is kind, and it is good value (a high score of around 9.0) · But it is a small property with few public reviews, and there is no breakfast or permanently staffed front desk · It is worth messaging the owner to confirm a room and comparing the latest reviews before booking.

faq.q: Are there other budget or pool options in Amnat Charoen?
faq.a: For a private pool villa in the same compound, try Jin Pool Villa Amnatcheroen · For a boutique feel or a budget base in town, compare it with Ramiarndao Boutique Place or Zwahotel Amnatcharoen · But if the brief is a new room with in-room essentials at a low price, JinPlace Hostel answers it squarely.
